Owner: agreed — that paragraph stacks jargon instead of saying what the library is.

Proposed replacement, for the docs-site editor (not landed here; Astro bead bd-01M19FPY1EC5QNTW6SBG3QYT3R is still unclaimed and this tree has no docs-site source to edit):

What storymodel4s does

storymodel4s is a Scala library for writing down what happens in a story, what a person later remembers of it, and how those two accounts line up. It does not collapse that comparison into one similarity score. It keeps the inspectable path: which source words support which claims, where recall matches or misses, what is uncertain, and which artifacts a later reader can reproduce.

I am routing the owner note to the Astro bead. I am not claiming docs-site.
